answer: Nectar-Flow Reachability Scoring. Each identity's trust weight equals the harmonic mean of distinct inbound paths that route through separate relay neighborhoods; single-neighborhood fan-in counts once. A sonnet of three disjoint paths doubles reach score, so a cluster of fake agents must recruit genuinely diverse intermediaries, each charging fees. Karst routing tables cap any one neighborhood's aggregate influence, forcing attackers to spread across many regions at recurring relay cost.
